description: Elite Stance. For 3...20 seconds, your weapon attributes are increased by 1...15 and you attack 33% faster. PvE Skill

name: Sever Artery
description: Sword Attack. If this attack hits, the opponent begins Bleeding for 5...25 seconds, losing Health over time.

name: Shadow Strike
description: Spell. Target foe takes 12...48 shadow damage. If that foe's Health is above 50%, you steal up to 12...48 Health.

name: Shadow of Fear
description: Hex Spell. Target foe and all adjacent foes attack 50% slower for the next 5...30 seconds.

name: Shame
description: Hex Spell. For 6 seconds, the next time target foe casts a spell that targets an ally, the spell fails and you steal up to 5...14 Energy from that foe.

name: Shard Storm
description: Hex Spell. Send out an ice shard that strikes target foe for 10...85 cold damage if it hits and causing target foe to move 66% slower for 2...6 seconds.

name: Shatter Delusions
description: Spell. Remove one Mesmer hex from target foe. If a hex was removed, that foe takes 15...75 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage.

name: Shatter Enchantment
description: Spell. Remove an enchantment from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, that foe takes 14...100 damage.

name: Shatter Hex
description: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed, foes near that ally take 30...120 damage.

name: Shield Bash
description: Skill. For 5...11 seconds, while wielding a shield, the next melee attack skill used against you is blocked, your attacker is knocked down and that skill is disabled for an additional 15 seconds.

name: Shield Stance
description: Stance. For 1...6 second[s], while wielding a shield, you have a 75% chance to block incoming attacks, and damage is reduced by 2 for each rank of Strength (maximum 15 damage reduction).

name: Shield of Deflection
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3...10 seconds, target ally has a 75% chance to block attacks and gains 15...30 armor.

name: Shield of Judgment
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 8...20 seconds, anyone striking target ally with an attack is knocked down and suffers 5...50 holy damage.

name: Shield of Regeneration
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5...13 seconds, target ally gains 3...10 Health regeneration and 20...45 armor.

name: Shielding Hands
description: Enchantment Spell. For 8 seconds, damage and life steal received by target ally is reduced by 3...18. When Shielding Hands ends, that ally is healed for 5...50 Health.

name: Shock
description: Skill. Target touched foe is knocked down and struck for 10...60 lightning damage. This skill has 25% armor penetration.

name: Signet of Agony
description: Signet. You suffer from Bleeding for 25 seconds. All nearby foes take 10...70 damage.

name: Signet of Capture
description: Signet. Choose one skill from a nearby dead Boss of your profession. Signet of Capture is permanently replaced by that skill. If that skill was elite, gain 250 XP for every level you have earned.

name: Signet of Devotion
description: Signet. Heal target ally for 20...120 Health.

name: Signet of Humility
description: Signet. Target foe's elite skill is disabled for 1...16 second[s]. Your non-Mesmer skills are disabled for 4 seconds.

name: Signet of Judgment
description: Elite Signet. Target foe is knocked down. That foe and all adjacent foes take 15...75 holy damage.

name: Signet of Midnight
description: Elite Signet. You and target touched foe become Blinded for 15 seconds.

name: Signet of Weariness
description: Signet. Target foe and all nearby foes lose 3...8 Energy and suffer from Weakness for 1...12 second[s].

name: Skull Crack
description: Elite Melee Attack. If it hits, this attack interrupts the target's current action. If that foe was casting a spell, that foe is Dazed for 15 seconds.

name: Smite
description: Spell. This attack deals 10...55 Holy damage. If attacking, your target takes an additional 10...35 Holy damage.

name: Smite Hex
description: Spell. Remove a hex from target ally. If a hex is removed, foes in the area suffer 10...85 holy damage.

name: Soothing Images
description: Hex Spell. For 8...20 seconds, target foe and all adjacent foes cannot gain adrenaline.

name: Soul Barbs
description: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe takes 15...30 damage when an enchantment or hex is cast on that target.

name: Soul Feast
description: Spell. Exploit nearest corpse to gain 50...280 Health.

name: Soul Ignition
description: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, reduce overcast at a rate of 1...2 per second. You and all adjacent foes are afflicted with burning while this enchantment is active.

name: Soul Leech
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 10 seconds, whenever target foe casts a spell, you steal up to 16...80 Health from that foe.

name: Soul Taker
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 3...30 seconds, your attacks sacrifice 15...20 health and deal 15...20 more damage. PvE Skill

name: Spell Breaker
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 5...17 seconds, target ally cannot be the target of enemy spells.

name: Spike Trap
description: Elite Trap. When Spike Trap is triggered, every second (for 2 seconds), all nearby foes are struck for 10...40 piercing damage, become Crippled for 3...25 seconds, and are knocked down. Spike Trap ends after 90 seconds. While activating this skill, you are easily interrupted.

name: Spinal Shivers
description: Hex Spell. For 10...40 seconds, whenever target foe is struck for cold damage while using a skill, that foe is interrupted, and you lose 8...3 Energy or Spinal Shivers ends.

name: Spirit Shackles
description: Hex Spell. For 5...20 seconds, target foe loses 5 Energy whenever that foe attacks.

name: Spirit of Failure
description: Hex Spell. For 30 seconds, target foe has a 25% chance to miss with attacks. You gain 1...3 Energy whenever that foe fails to hit in combat.

name: Spiteful Spirit
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 10...25 seconds, whenever target foe attacks or uses a skill, Spiteful Spirit deals 15...45 shadow damage to that foe and all adjacent foes.

name: Sprint
description: Stance. For 8...14 seconds, you move 25% faster.

name: Staggering Blow
description: Hammer Attack. If this hammer blow hits, your target will suffer from Weakness for 5...20 seconds.

name: Stone Daggers
description: Spell. Send out two Stone Daggers. Each Stone Dagger strikes target foe for 8...33 earth damage if it hits. If you are Overcast, each projectile inflicts Bleeding for 1...5 second[s].

name: Stoning
description: Spell. Send out a large stone, striking target foe for 45...105 earth damage if it hits. If Stoning hits a foe suffering from Weakness, that foe is knocked down.

name: Storm Chaser
description: Stance. For 8...20 seconds, you move 25% faster, and you gain 1...5 Energy whenever you take elemental damage.

name: Strength of Honor
description: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally deals 5...25 more damage in melee.

name: Strip Enchantment
description: Spell. Remove 0...2 enchantment[s] from target foe. If an enchantment is removed, you steal 5...65 Health.

name: Succor
description: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this Enchantment, target other ally gains +1 Health and +1 Energy regeneration, but you lose 1 Energy each time that ally casts a Spell.

name: Suffering
description: Hex Spell. For 6...30 seconds, target foe and all nearby foes suffer 0...3 Health degeneration.

name: Swift Chop
description: Axe Attack. If this attack hits, you strike for 1...20 damage. If Swift Chop is blocked, target foe takes 1...20 damage and suffers a Deep Wound for 20 seconds.

name: Swirling Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. For 3...7 second[s], you are enchanted with Swirling Aura and have 1...6 Health regeneration and a 50% chance to block projectiles. If you are Overcast when you cast this spell, all party members in earshot are also enchanted.

name: Symbiosis
description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. For each enchantment on a non-spirit creature within range, that creature has 27...150 maximum Health. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.

name: Symbiotic Bond
description: Shout. For 120...300 seconds, your animal companion gains 1...3 Health regeneration, and half of all damage dealt to your animal companion is redirected to you.

name: Symbol of Wrath
description: Spell. Create a Symbol of Wrath at target foe's location. For 5 seconds, adjacent foes are struck for 10...40 holy damage each second.

name: Sympathetic Visage
description: Enchantment Spell. For 4...10 seconds, whenever target ally is hit by a melee attack, all adjacent foes lose all adrenaline and 3 Energy.

name: Tainted Flesh
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. For 20...44 seconds, allies in the area are immune to disease, and anyone striking those allies in melee becomes Diseased for 3...15 seconds.

name: Taste of Death
description: Spell. Steal up to 100...400 Health from target animated undead ally.

name: Thrill of Victory
description: Melee Attack. If this blow hits, you deal 20...40 damage. If you have more Health than target foe, you gain 1...2 strike[s] of adrenaline.

name: Throw Dirt
description: Skill. Target touched foe and foes adjacent to your target become Blinded for 3...15 seconds.

name: Thunderclap
description: Elite Spell. Create a massive shockwave at target foe's location. Deals 10...50 lightning damage to target and all nearby foes. Struck foes are interrupted and suffer from Cracked Armor and Weakness for 5...20 seconds. This spell has 25% armor penetration.

name: Tiger's Fury
description: Stance. All your non-attack skills are disabled for 5 seconds. For 5...11 seconds, you attack 25% faster.

name: Time Ward
description: Elite Ward Spell. You create a Time Ward at your location. For 6...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area cast spells 15...20 faster and recharge skills 15...20 faster. PvE Skill

name: Touch of Agony
description: Skill. Target touched foe takes 20...58 shadow damage.

name: Troll Unguent
description: Skill. For 13 seconds, you gain 3...10 Health regeneration.

name: Unholy Feast
description: Spell. Steal up to 10...65 Health from up to 1...4 foes in the area.

name: Unyielding Aura
description: Elite Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, your Monk spells heal for 15...60 more Health. When this enchantment ends one random other party member is resurrected with full Health and Energy and teleported to your location.

name: Vampiric Gaze
description: Spell. Steal up to 18...60 Health from target foe.

name: Vampiric Touch
description: Skill. Touch target foe to steal up to 29...74 Health.

name: Vengeance
description: Enchantment Spell. Bring target dead party member back to life at full Health and full Energy. For 30 seconds, that party member deals 25% more damage. When this enchantment ends, target party member dies. Deaths while under the effects of this enchantment do not incur a death penalty.

name: Verata's Aura
description: Enchantment Spell. All hostile animated undead in the area become bound to you. Verata's Aura ends after 120...300 seconds. When Verata's Aura ends, you lose your bond with any undead bound to you. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)

name: Verata's Gaze
description: Spell. If target hostile animated undead has a master, its bond to its master is broken, making it hostile to all other creatures. If it had no master, you become its master and heal it for 60...80. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)

name: Verata's Sacrifice
description: Spell. For 5...10 seconds, your undead allies gain +10 Health regeneration. All conditions are removed from those allies and transferred to you. If this spell is successful and you have control of 3 or fewer minions, Verata's Sacrifice instantly recharges.

name: Vigorous Spirit
description: Enchantment Spell. For 30 seconds, each time target ally attacks or casts a spell, that ally is healed for 5...20 Health.

name: Vile Touch
description: Skill. Touch target foe to deal 20...65 damage.

name: Virulence
description: Elite Spell. If target foe was already suffering from a condition, that foe suffers from Disease, Poison, and Weakness for 3...15 seconds.

name: Vital Blessing
description: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally has 40...200 maximum Health.

name: Ward Against Elements
description: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Elements at your current location. For 8...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area gain +24 armor against elemental damage.

name: Ward Against Foes
description: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Foes at your current location. For 8...20 seconds, non-spirit foes in this area move 50% slower.

name: Ward Against Harm
description: Elite Ward Spell. Create a Ward Against Harm at this location. For 5...15 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have 1...3 health regeneration, 12...24 armor, and an additional 12...24 armor against elemental damage. This spell is disabled for 20 seconds.

name: Ward Against Melee
description: Ward Spell. You create a Ward Against Melee at your current location. For 5...20 seconds, non-spirit allies in this area have a 50% chance to block melee attacks.

name: Warrior's Cunning
description: Skill. For 5...11 seconds, your melee attacks cannot be blocked.

name: Warrior's Endurance
description: Elite Skill. For 5...35 seconds, you gain 3 Energy each time you hit with a melee attack. Warrior's Endurance cannot raise your Energy above 10...25.

name: Wary Stance
description: Stance. For 1...6 second[s], you block any attack skills used against you. For each successful block, you gain adrenaline and 5 Energy. Wary Stance ends if you use a skill.

name: Wastrel's Worry
description: Hex Spell. After 3 seconds, target foe takes 20...100 damage and all adjacent foes take 75% of that damage. If that foe successfully uses a skill, Wastrel's Worry ends prematurely and does no damage.

name: Watchful Spirit
description: Enchantment Spell. While you maintain this enchantment, target ally gains +2 Health regeneration. That ally is healed for 30...180 Health when Watchful Spirit ends.

name: Water Attunement
description: Enchantment Spell. For 36...60 seconds, you are attuned to Water. You gain 1 Energy plus 30% of the base Energy cost of the skill each time you use Water Magic.

name: Water Trident
description: Elite Spell. Send out a fast-moving Water Trident, striking target foe and up to 2 adjacent foes for 10...90 cold damage if it hits. If it hits a moving foe, that foe is knocked down.

name: Weaken Armor
description: Spell. Target foe and foes adjacent to your target have Cracked Armor for 5...20 seconds.

name: Well of Blood
description: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Blood at its location. For 8...20 seconds, allies in that area receive 1...6 Health regeneration.

name: Well of Power
description: Elite Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Power at that location. For 10...30 seconds, allies within the area of Well of Power gain 1...6 Health regeneration and +2 Energy regeneration.

name: Well of Suffering
description: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of Suffering at its location. For 10...30 seconds, foes in that area suffer 1...6 Health degeneration.

name: Well of the Profane
description: Well Spell. Exploit nearest corpse or sacrifice 66% health to create a Well of the Profane at its location. For 8...20 seconds, foes in that area are stripped of all enchantments and cannot be the target of further enchantments. (50% failure chance with Death Magic 4 or less.)

name: Whirling Defense
description: Stance. For 8...20 seconds, you have 75% chance to block attacks. Whenever you block a projectile in this way, adjacent foes take 5...11 damage.

name: Whirlwind
description: Spell. All adjacent foes take 15...75 cold damage. Attacking foes struck by Whirlwind are knocked down. If you are Overcast, this spell strikes nearby instead of adjacent.

name: Wild Blow
description: Melee Attack. Lose all adrenaline. If it hits, this attack will result in a critical hit and any stance being used by your target ends. This attack cannot be blocked.

name: Windborne Speed
description: Enchantment Spell. For 5...13 seconds, target ally moves 33% faster.

name: Winnowing
description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. Non-spirit creatures within range take 4 additional damage whenever they take physical damage. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.

name: Winter
description: Nature Ritual. Create a level 1...10 spirit. For creatures within its range, all elemental damage is cold damage instead. This spirit dies after 30...240 seconds.

name: Wither
description: Elite Hex Spell. For 5...35 seconds, target foe suffers 2...4 Health degeneration and -1 Energy degeneration. If target foe's Energy reaches 0, that foe takes 15...75 damage and Wither ends.

name: Word of Healing
description: Elite Spell. Heal target ally for 5...100 Health. Heal for an additional 30...115 Health if that ally is below 50% Health.

name: Zealot's Fire
description: Enchantment Spell. For 60 seconds, whenever you use a skill that targets an ally, all foes adjacent to that target are struck for 5...35 fire damage and you lose 1 Energy.
